title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1971-03-03
lineage: 1st generation reels (Revox A77) > Tascam DA-3000 > dBpoweramp 2496 > Adobe Audition CC 2020 > TLH flac2496
source: Master Soundboard Reels > Pat Lee's 1st generation reels

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a one‑set Fillmore West benefit, with Pigpen’s organ mixed too loudly but overall a solid performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard tape of the last Dead show at Fillmore West, where they played only a single set for a benefit. Reviewers note that the organ levels are exaggerated compared to the live experience, making it feel less like being there, though the overall mix remains clear and enjoyable. The performance itself is remembered fondly, earning a solid 4‑star rating.

ai_rating.rationale: A single detailed 4‑star review highlights a good musical showing and mostly clear soundboard recording, with only the organ balance noted as a drawback.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix but Pigpen's organ is mixed overly loud compared to the live hall; not fully representative of the in‑venue sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Single benefit set – concise and nostalgic, remembered as the last Fillmore West appearance.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is mixed much louder than it sounded live, affecting realism of the recording.
